{{CharInfobox |color={{normal color}} |corecolor={{normal color light}} |bordercolor={{normal color dark}} |name=Luna Carson |jname=ルナ・カーソン |tmname=Luna Carson |image=Luna Carson.png |size=200px |caption= |gender=Female |region=[[Johto]] |relatives=[[Luka Carson]] (older sister) |anime=yes |epnum=Mewtwo Returns |epname=Mewtwo Returns |enva=[[Leah Applebaum]] |java=[[Aya Hisakawa]] }} '''Luna Carson''' (Japanese: '''ルナ・カーソン''' ''Luna Carson'') is a supporting character who appeared in ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'', and the younger sister of [[Luka Carson]]. Luna lives at the [[Mount Quena#Purity Canyon|Purity Canyon]] rest stop lodge, where she helps tourists and continues her Pokémon habitat research around [[Mount Quena]]. She took {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, and {{an|Misty}} on a guided boat tour to showcase her local area's pristine condition and the many {{type|Bug}}s that call it home. Later, both she and [[Cullen Calix]] helped Ash, {{ashfr}}, and {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}} fight against {{TRT}}. She and Cullen quickly struck up a close friendship, both sharing interests in research. Her environmental consciousness and personal connection to the Purity Canyon area rubbed off on Cullen, as he decided to instead make a synthetic medicine based on [[Mount Quena#Clarity Lake|Clarity Lake]]'s spring water. Even so, she and Cullen had their memories wiped by Mewtwo to avoid potential threats to the lives of it and the clone Pokémon.
